title: Muder Sheep
description: Sightings of MuderSheep have been discovered, whose sole purpose in life is to kill at night! You must escape from the killer sheep and survive!
body:
**Murder Sheep - The Killer Sheep Horror Mod**

**Escape the Murder Sheep… or become their prey!**

In this terrifying mod, adorable sheep hide a deadly secret:

*   **Nighttime Terror**: Murder Sheep spawn at night, their sole purpose is to hunt and kill players!
*   **Fake Sheep Trap**: Daytime sheep look normal… but punch one, and it reveals its true killer form!
*   **Fragile Radar Tool**: Craft a Radar to detect nearby Murder Sheep (shows position & warning message). It breaks after use – use wisely!
*   **Survival Challenge**: Run, hide, or fight back… but escaping is recommended! It is currently in development! New features will be added in the future!
